title: 第94章 我们都在槐树内第93章 我刚好像听见婴儿哭了
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
这次走得很顺利，只花了一个时辰，三人就穿过重重密林来到山谷之后。
按照师姐给的地图，这块区域并没有什么强大的妖兽驻守，可以稍微地放松心神。
但李婉心中仍有淡淡的不安在萦绕着。
三人一刻不歇地开始寻找。
这并不是一个很轻易的活，如果那么容易，宗门不会一个就给五十那么高的贡献点。
李婉三人在找寻蜜参果的过程中如遇见其他灵草灵果也会顺势收下。
毕竟来一趟不容易，有啥先拿啥吧，最后要是真找不到蜜参果，这些东西也能抵抵他们来一趟的路费。
哪知一语成谶，三人几乎要把这块地方翻了个，也没找见蜜参果的影子。
天又要黑了，李婉记挂着昨晚的声音，今天就有些抗拒再在谷中过夜。
“我们是继续还是回去？”
李婉问木青，这个任务是木青接的，队伍也是她拉的。
虽然之后她就做起了甩手掌柜，一路的决策都是她来定下，但是李婉觉得这种时候还是问问她比较好。
木青沉吟半晌，“回去吧。”
虽然此处她们没有遇见棘手的妖兽，但是她的心里下意识地忌惮这个地方。
贡献点虽可贵，小命价更高。
该怎么选，木青还是知道的。
两人的目光同时投到赵致然身上，赵致然点点头。
虽然很可惜这趟没有采到蜜参果，但至少他在此行中扭正了心性，往后修行中必当戒骄戒躁，如此方能长远。
这或许是他这一趟最好的收获。
“全力加速的话，我们在太阳彻底落山前就能到达山谷外围。”

李婉开始给自己身上贴急符，木青祭出她的树叶将她裹住，赵致然已经踩上了他的飞剑。
一切准备妥当。
出发！
等等！这是什么！
三人还没离开原地一寸，天空中突然伸来无数只绿藤，将三人捆粽子，拉进巨大的树冠之中。
物体落地的沉重声音响起。
李婉抬头，发现自己被那树藤绑进了它身体的树洞里。
手下传来一股难以忽视的阴寒之气，那股凉气穿过皮肤，直直地作用在骨血之中。
李婉自从凿灵后，寻常的低温都很难被她感知，这还是头一次有温度让她觉得寒凉刺骨。
她心中的凝重更甚。
这处树洞很宽广，头上的树洞上斜斜的打下一束光，勉强能看清整个树洞内部。
树洞内并非空无一物，而是郁郁葱葱的长满了各色植物，李婉的眼睛凝固在一处。
那是依靠着大树树干生长的一棵小树，树上挂满了橙色的果子，如一盏盏可爱的小灯笼。
果子很多，多得枝丫都被压弯，树枝间，筑着一个灰色的巢，能听见里面蜜蜂的嗡嗡声。
那是……
蜜参树！
他们此行的目标！
树藤在将他们绑进了树洞后就松开了三人，故而现在他们是自由的。
content_en:
The walk went smoothly this time. It only took an hour for the three of them to walk through the dense forest and arrive at the back of the valley.
According to the map given by the senior sister, there are no powerful monsters stationed in this area, so you can relax a little.
But Li Wan still felt a touch of uneasiness lingering in her heart.
The three of them started searching without stopping.
This is not an easy job. If it were that easy, the sect would not give someone as high as fifty contribution points.
When Li Wan and the other three come across other spiritual grasses and spiritual fruits while searching for honey ginseng fruits, they will accept them.
After all, it's not easy to come here, so just grab what you have first. If they can't find the honey ginseng fruit in the end, these things can be used to cover their travel expenses.
Unexpectedly, the words came true. The three of them almost turned over the place, but could not find any trace of honey ginseng fruit.
It was getting dark again. Li Wan remembered the voice last night and felt a little reluctant to spend the night in the valley again today.
"Should we continue or go back?"
Li Wan asked Mu Qing, Mu Qing took this task and she was the one who led the team.
Although she later became the hands-off shopkeeper and made all the decisions along the way, Li Wan felt that it was better to ask her at this time.
Mu Qing pondered for a while, "Go back."
Although they did not encounter any troublesome monsters here, she was subconsciously afraid of this place.
Although contribution points are valuable, lives are more expensive.
Mu Qing still knows how to choose.
The two of them cast their eyes on Zhao Zhiran at the same time, and Zhao Zhiran nodded.
Although it is a pity that he did not collect honey ginseng fruit on this trip, at least he corrected his mind during this trip. He must guard against arrogance and impatience in his future practice, so that he can survive in the long run.
This may be his best takeaway from this trip.
"If we accelerate at full speed, we can reach the outskirts of the valley before the sun completely sets."
Li Wan began to put urgent charms on herself, Mu Qing offered her leaves to wrap her up, and Zhao Zhiran had already stepped on his flying sword.
Everything is ready.
Set off!
etc! What's this!
Before the three of them had moved an inch from where they were, countless green vines suddenly stretched out from the sky, tied the three of them into rice dumplings, and pulled them into the huge canopy.
The heavy sound of an object falling to the ground was heard.
Li Wan looked up and found that she was tied into the tree hole of its body by the tree vine.
There was an air of coldness under his hands that was difficult to ignore. The cold air passed through the skin and acted directly on the bones and blood.
Since Li Wan's death, it was difficult for her to feel the normal low temperature. This was the first time that the temperature made her feel bitingly cold.
The solemnity in her heart was even greater.
This tree hole is very wide. A beam of light shines diagonally from the tree hole above my head, and I can barely see the entire inside of the tree hole.
The tree hole was not empty, but was lushly filled with various plants. Li Wan's eyes were fixed on one spot.
It was a small tree growing on the trunk of a big tree. The tree was covered with orange fruits, like cute little lanterns.
There are so many fruits that the branches are bent. Between the branches, there is a gray nest, and the buzzing of bees can be heard inside.
That's...
Honey ginseng tree!
The goal of their trip!
The tree vine released the three of them after tying them into the tree hole, so now they are free.
